purpose: Keep concrete weighted polynomial-coordinate data separate from proved projection, grading, and pairing identities.

nodes.title: Weighted polynomial coordinate features
nodes.statement_tex: For $1\leq k\leq N$, index the degree-$k$ Euclidean block by all maps $\iota:\operatorname{Fin}k\to\operatorname{Fin}n$ and define $\Phi_k(x)_\iota=\sqrt{2^k/k!}\prod_jx_{\iota(j)}$. The whole feature space is the direct sum of these coordinate blocks; the block submodules and their orthogonal projections are concrete definitions.
nodes.status_note: Concrete definitions contain no placeholders; algebraic identities are separate theorems.

nodes.title: Exact block projections and feature pairings
nodes.statement_tex: The degree-$k$ projection keeps exactly the coordinates in block $k$ and annihilates the others. These projections form an orthogonal grading. Moreover $\langle\Phi(x),\Phi(y)\rangle=\sum_{k=1}^N(2^k/k!)\langle x,y\rangle^k$ and $\langle P_k\Phi(x),\Phi(y)\rangle=(2^k/k!)\langle x,y\rangle^k$. All dimensions and truncation orders are natural numbers, including zero.
